clips.speaker: John Woods
clips.title: Lombard Odier亚洲CIO：新经济板块仅占中国经济的15-20%，但机会充足
title_lines: 新经济板块仅占中国经济的15-20%
但机会充足，需精选标的

subtitles.en: We don't see it ending we seem to have a new entrant every quarter or so and it just adds to the momentum behind as I say the tech the AI the renewables the green energy space which is driving that part of the economy.
subtitles.zh: 我们认为这一趋势不会结束，几乎每个季度都有新参与者加入，这为科技、人工智能、可再生能源和绿色能源领域增添了动力，推动着经济的那一部分。

subtitles.en: It is eminently investible in our minds but it's important to caution that it's probably only 15 to 20% of the economy.
subtitles.zh: 在我们看来，这非常值得配置，但需要提醒的是，它可能只占经济的15%到20%。

subtitles.en: There's a there's perhaps a more constrained landscape out there which is a bit of a little more challenged as we saw from the China numbers published a couple of data yesterday but overall as I say we still see ample opportunity in the in the new entrance space.
subtitles.zh: 另一方面，可能有一些领域面临更多挑战，正如我们从昨天发布的中国数据中看到的，但总体而言，我们仍然在新经济领域看到充足的机会。

subtitles.en: So the new China is how would you play that is that more onshore playing now because the hardware is there or is it the monetization place that you get off shore like Hong Kong. Yes both to an extent we see a lot more tech in the MSEI China index so that is much more of a new China way of playing it and absolutely the same in the H share market as well but there are onshore opportunities as well maybe single line.
subtitles.zh: 那么新经济中国如何布局？是在岸市场还是离岸市场？两者都有一定机会。我们在MSCI中国指数中看到更多科技股，这更多是新经济中国的玩法，H股市场也是如此，但在岸市场也有机会，可能是个股机会。

clips.speaker_context: Asia CIO and head of investment solutions, Asia, at Lombard Odier

clips.speaker: John Woods
clips.title: Lombard Odier亚洲CIO：中国市场不再是简单的看多持有，需精选单家公司
title_lines: 中国市场不再是简单的看多持有
需精选单家公司，板块和单家公司选择是关键

subtitles.en: Or some index exposure that the CSI 300 has a number of important participants and constituents but I think you have to be reasonably selective and discrete about the way that you play this because there's not one size fits all David as you know and the market isn't bifurcated in such a convenient way.
subtitles.zh: 或者通过指数配置，沪深300包含许多重要成分股，但我认为你必须相当有选择性和区分度，因为没有一刀切的方法，市场也不是那么简单分化的。

subtitles.en: Yeah you mentioned balanced exposure across onshore and offshore I mean the offshore side things has not quite played out maybe much of this year.
subtitles.zh: 你提到了在岸和离岸的平衡配置，离岸市场今年表现并不太好。

subtitles.en: What could kind of change that sort of narrative you think. We've been in a funk here. I mean because people are still questioning the monetization of AI for some of these big tech names.
subtitles.zh: 什么可能改变这种叙事？我们一直处于低迷状态，因为人们仍在质疑一些大型科技公司的人工智能变现能力。

subtitles.en: The names, the themes, the sectors we track are up 25% year to date, the broad indices are flat maybe up 2% or so. It's not a compelling buy and hold index story. I guess you might say it's more of a sector picker or stock pickers at market which is where the diamonds in the rough if you will or the opportunities are likely to be found.
subtitles.zh: 我们追踪的个股、主题和板块今年迄今上涨了25%，而宽基指数持平或仅上涨2%左右。这不是一个令人信服的买入并持有指数的故事。我认为这更像是一个板块选择或个股选择的市场，机会可能就在其中。

subtitles.en: Whether that's onshore or offshore is really down to the sector picker or the stock picker. But as I say it's much more of a discerning market now I think than a simple buy and hold directional trade that it was maybe in previous years.
subtitles.zh: 无论是在岸还是离岸，都取决于板块选择或个股选择。但正如我所说，现在的市场比前几年简单的买入并持有方向性交易要挑剔得多。

clips.speaker_context: Asia CIO and head of investment solutions, Asia, at Lombard Odier

clips.speaker: John Woods
clips.title: Lombard Odier亚洲CIO：新兴市场更看好韩国、台湾和巴西，利差交易有利
title_lines: 新兴市场更看好韩国、台湾和巴西
利差交易因高利率环境而有利

subtitles.en: So we talked about EM equities. This is a little massively an EM equity played. Have we missed out on any opportunities? I mean AI is obviously crowded out mind space completely almost. Well I mean the EM story for us is more a function of South Korea.
subtitles.zh: 我们谈到了新兴市场权益资产。这是新兴市场权益资产的表现。我们错过了什么机会吗？人工智能显然几乎占据了所有注意力。对我们来说，新兴市场的故事更多是关于韩国。

subtitles.en: It's Taiwan to an extent its South Korea and Brazil on value. That's how the preferred country status is being communicated. I mean it's one about valuations, it's one about underlying macro growth.
subtitles.zh: 一定程度上是台湾，还有韩国和巴西，基于价值。这就是优选国家的逻辑。这关乎估值，也关乎潜在宏观增长。

subtitles.en: The likelihood that certain central banks will remain on hold higher for longer meaning it's supportive of a carry trade from a currency perspective. Rather than the low yielders. So overall this play has outperformed developed markets yet to date and it's one that we will hold over into the second half of the year as well.
subtitles.zh: 某些央行可能更长时间维持高利率，这对货币利差交易有利，而不是低收益货币。总体而言，这一策略今年迄今跑赢发达市场，我们将在下半年继续持有。

subtitles.en: Is that carry trade still the end? That's the most favorable play. Well there's a number of candidates. There's that well in the Swiss brackets obviously a classic example as well. So is the Hong Kong dollar on a relative basis with the US and of course the yen as well.
subtitles.zh: 利差交易仍然是最有利的策略吗？有很多候选。瑞士法郎显然是一个经典例子。港币相对于美元也是，当然还有日元。

subtitles.en: And even more so given options pricing suggesting that it's likely to tick a little higher. But yeah the overall carry trade I think favors these higher yielding currencies. And predominantly they tend to sit in the emerging market complex.
subtitles.zh: 期权定价显示这些货币可能进一步走高。总体而言，利差交易有利于这些高收益货币，而它们主要存在于新兴市场。

clips.speaker_context: Asia CIO and head of investment solutions, Asia, at Lombard Odier

clips.speaker: Catherine Lim
clips.title: 彭博分析师Catherine Lim：阿里获AI审批，成苹果在华关键伙伴

subtitles.en: Let's talk this through. And I guess let's start off with why these approvals actually matter for Alibaba, Catherine.
subtitles.zh: 我们来聊聊。首先，这些审批对阿里巴巴为什么重要？

subtitles.en: Well, this is a long-awaited approval. The tie-up is not new. What effectively came true really was that with the approval.
subtitles.zh: 这是期待已久的审批。合作本身并不新鲜，真正实现的是审批本身。

subtitles.en: We could see it as Beijing effectively certifying that Qwen is an AI infrastructure platform that is safe, controllable, and compliant for mass market use in China.
subtitles.zh: 可以看作北京方面认证了通义千问是一个安全、可控、合规的AI基础设施平台，可用于中国大众市场。

subtitles.en: And this is going to be important to Alibaba because it really upgrades its status in the AI hierarchy. So now global and domestic players can plug into it when they want to scale AI in China.
subtitles.zh: 这对阿里巴巴很重要，因为它提升了其在AI层级中的地位。现在国内外参与者都可以接入，在中国扩展AI应用。

subtitles.en: So while it doesn't really change Alibaba's earnings profile, it does look like it is going to be the gatekeeper for some of the foreign players like Apple in China.
subtitles.zh: 虽然这不会改变阿里巴巴的盈利状况，但它似乎将成为苹果等外国玩家在中国的守门人。

clips.speaker: Catherine Lim
clips.title: 彭博分析师Catherine Lim：阿里与苹果合作战略意义大于财务影响
title_lines: 战略意义大于财务影响
title_highlights: 战略意义大于财务影响

subtitles.en: Yeah, I'm sure it's going to be a big catalyst for Apple, given that they've been waiting for so long for this sort of access. What about for Alibaba? What's the earnings impact you could see?
subtitles.zh: 这对苹果肯定是重大催化剂，他们等这种接入等了很久。对阿里巴巴呢？会有什么盈利影响？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I hear you. For Alibaba, it's really more strategic than financial. We don't really yet have visibility on the revenue sharing, usage levels, and how Apple, for instance, prices some of their features in China.
subtitles.zh: 我明白。对阿里来说，这更多是战略意义而非财务。我们还不清楚收入分成、使用量以及苹果如何在中国为其功能定价。

subtitles.en: And let's not forget that Apple is still rebuilding its market share in China against Huawei and other Android brands.
subtitles.zh: 别忘了苹果还在中国重建市场份额，对手是华为和其他安卓品牌。

subtitles.en: So coming back to Alibaba, as it actually works with Apple on this, it is going to be more strategic and the near-term impact on Alibaba I don't really expect to have a material impact or swing the needle.
subtitles.zh: 回到阿里，与苹果合作更多是战略层面，短期我不认为会有实质性影响或改变局面。

subtitles.en: Alibaba will continue to invest in R&D and what it needs to do to cultivate some of these authentic or new spending behaviors in China.
subtitles.zh: 阿里将继续投入研发，培育中国市场上新的消费行为。

clips.speaker: Catherine Lim
clips.title: 彭博分析师Catherine Lim：中国AI竞赛双轨并行，阿里获监管信任成关键
title_lines: 阿里获监管信任成关键

subtitles.en: Okay. So this is another hardware play then. You have Huawei, ZTE. How does this reshape the AI race in China?
subtitles.zh: 所以这是另一个硬件布局？有华为、中兴。这如何重塑中国的AI竞赛？

subtitles.en: Yeah. China's AI race can be broken up into two tracks. One is hardware-centric ecosystems from Huawei to Xiaomi, and cloud-based AI services from Baidu.
subtitles.zh: 中国AI竞赛可分为两条轨道：一是从华为到小米的硬件生态，二是百度的云端AI服务。

subtitles.en: They will continue to embed their own models into devices and apps. The other track is where Alibaba comes in, because it is an infrastructure provider that foreign platforms can depend on.
subtitles.zh: 它们会继续将自有模型嵌入设备和应用。另一条轨道是阿里巴巴，因为它是一个外国平台可以依赖的基础设施提供商。

subtitles.en: The Apple deal itself doesn't mean it's going to knock off Huawei or Xiaomi. They will continue to lead on integrated device plus AI, if you ask me.
subtitles.zh: 苹果交易本身并不意味着它会击败华为或小米。在我看来，它们仍将在设备+AI集成方面领先。

subtitles.en: Really what we now should focus on is that in China itself, the regulatory trust, the governance, it's going to be as critical as the raw model platform itself. With this sign-off from the authorities, Alibaba can now formally be recognized as a partner that can keep global AI within China.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在真正应该关注的是，在中国，监管信任和治理将与模型平台本身一样关键。有了监管批准，阿里巴巴现在可以被正式视为一个能将全球AI留在中国的合作伙伴。
zh_highlights: 全球AI留在中国的合作伙伴
en_highlights: partner that can keep global AI within China

subtitles.en: And again, with this sign-off from the authorities, I think Alibaba can now formally be recognized as a partner that can keep global AI within China.
subtitles.zh: 再次强调，有了监管批准，我认为阿里巴巴现在可以被正式视为一个能将全球AI留在中国的合作伙伴。
zh_highlights: 全球AI留在中国的合作伙伴

clips.speaker: David Qu
clips.title: 彭博经济学家曲天石：信贷数据疲软，政策加码信号已现

subtitles.en: June credit is the latest sign that the economy needs stronger support from the PBOC.
subtitles.zh: 6月信贷数据是最新信号，显示经济需要央行更强支持。

subtitles.en: Everyone's watching the Politburo meeting now, maybe for the next sort of course of action.
subtitles.zh: 所有人都在关注政治局会议，期待下一步政策方向。

subtitles.en: But was the credit data, plus what we got yesterday? Was it soft enough to finally see some stimulus, you think?
subtitles.zh: 但信贷数据加上昨天的数据，是否疲软到足以触发刺激措施？

subtitles.en: Well, I think the data and the credit is already enough for the PBOC and the fiscal side to push the economy harder.
subtitles.zh: 我认为数据和信贷已经足以让央行和财政方面加大经济推动力度。

subtitles.en: But the thing is that whether we can see it soon. Because we have been there, I mean the policy stance has been there for a long time.
subtitles.zh: 但问题是能否很快看到行动。因为政策立场已经维持了很久。

subtitles.en: And it seems that the authorities are not so in the hurry to push it. Yes, that is why we are looking at the upcoming Politburo meeting to see whether the top leaders will allow or let the PBOC to do that.
subtitles.zh: 当局似乎并不急于推动。是的，所以我们关注即将召开的政治局会议，看高层是否会允许央行行动。

subtitles.en: And if we read the early sign from the state council, it already called for more accommodative policies. And also for the so-called anti-sacredical adjustments. So I think that is the early sign.
subtitles.zh: 从国务院的早期信号看，已经要求更宽松的政策，以及所谓的逆周期调节。我认为这是早期信号。

subtitles.en: But the thing is that what time they will do it? Well, aren't interest rates, for example? Are they accommodative enough? Like what more could we see?
subtitles.zh: 但问题是什么时候行动？比如利率，是否已经足够宽松？我们还能看到什么？

clips.speaker: David Qu
clips.title: 彭博经济学家曲天石：市场利率仍高，央行需释放更强信号

subtitles.en: No, the reason why we say it's not low enough, because if you look at the, you cannot only look at the PBOC's policy rate. You need to also need to look at the market rate.
subtitles.zh: 不，我们说利率还不够低，是因为不能只看央行的政策利率，还要看市场利率。

subtitles.en: And if you look at the long rates and the market rate, it's still much higher than the return on asset. The company's return on asset or the household's rental yield much higher.
subtitles.zh: 长期利率和市场利率仍远高于资产回报率，企业资产回报率或家庭租金收益率都低得多。

subtitles.en: So that it means it has a lot of room to get lower. I mean the market rate. And the problem is how you can get the market rate lower?
subtitles.zh: 这意味着市场利率有很大下行空间。问题是如何让市场利率降下来？

subtitles.en: The PBOC need to show the attitude. To show their willingness to get the rates lower. How? Well, it's mechanism then, because they have the short end, which they're more focused on right now.
subtitles.zh: 央行需要表明态度，展示降低利率的意愿。怎么做？机制问题，他们目前更关注短端。

clips.speaker: David Qu
clips.title: 彭博经济学家曲天石：央行需引导预期，银行才会降低长期利率
title_lines: 银行才会降低长期利率

subtitles.en: But then suddenly we have to go back to the old playbook. And the benchmark rates, which tend to move some of the market rates even further, correct me from wrong.
subtitles.zh: 但突然要回到旧剧本，基准利率往往能带动部分市场利率进一步下行，我说得对吗？

subtitles.en: That is the problem. If you return to 20 years ago, things could be easier. But now it is a market oriented system, right?
subtitles.zh: 问题就在这里。如果回到20年前，事情会更容易。但现在是市场化体系，对吧？

subtitles.en: And the banks need to have certain interest rate margin so that they keep their profit. So what the PBOC can do, right?
subtitles.zh: 银行需要一定的利差来维持利润。那么央行能做什么呢？

subtitles.en: You need to make the market believe you are going to do more using ahead. And so that the bank will lower their long rates. That is the channel.
subtitles.zh: 你需要让市场相信你会提前采取更多行动，这样银行才会降低长期利率。这就是传导渠道。
